The agent reasoned that the 47 GB/s result came from having too few active blocks and too little parallel work per output.   • Scales and zeros: [N, K//128]

Lanes read consecutive bytes, unpacked two int4 values per byte, applied the group scale and zero, accumulated products, then reduced across the warp. The input vector was cooperatively loaded into shared memory.
